scripts.dev: lsof -ti:3000,3001,3002,3006,3007 2>/dev/null | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'next dev' 2>/dev/null; next dev
scripts.dev:restart: for port in 3000 3001 3002 3006 3007; do pids=$(lsof -ti:$port 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$pids" ] && kill -9 $pids 2>/dev/null; done; pkill -f 'next dev' 2>/dev/null; rm -rf .next && next dev
scripts.deploy:reviewa: node scripts/build-reviewa.mjs && curl -fsSL https://reviewa.work/cli.mjs -o /tmp/reviewa.mjs && node /tmp/reviewa.mjs update epbhm84q out
